newsitem.title: UK: Europay says European card network grew 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: Europay says European card network grew 14 pct.

text.p: Europay International, the 7,000 member bank payment services company, on Wednesday said the number of plastic cards bearing Europay/Mastercard brands grew by 14 percent across Europe to just under 150 million.
This puts Europay some 50 million cards ahead of its nearest competitor Visa International.
In the UK, the brands, which include Maestro, Cirrus and Eurocard-Mastercard, grew by 21 percent, with a total transaction value of 18.6 billion stg, a rise of 18 percent over 1995.

Within the growth in cards, three times as many new debit cards were issued than credit cards, while cross-border ATM transactions grew by 27 percent over 1995, with 4.45 billion stg of cash withdrawn from the ATM network.
Europay said it continued to dominate the German market with a market share of 92 percent, quadrupled its Spanish issuance to over 1.3 million cards and nearly doubled cards in Turkey to 4.1 million.
